scientific.integrity: The proof is a direct linear-algebra argument from the published anti-admissibility definitions. Characteristic two is handled by a necessary-and-sufficient parity argument, and every remaining case has an explicit surjective construction.
limitations: Only affine pencils and elementary abelian target groups are classified.
No statement is made for projective pencils or general supersolvable arrangements.
The finite stress test is corroborative only; the proof is uniform.

title: Exact smooth spectra of affine pencil line arrangements
